title: dianthus furcatus subsp. geminiflorus
intro: Dianthus furcatus subsp. geminiflorus, commonly known as Rock Pink, is a perennial plant species within the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). The health benefits of Rock Pink include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. Therapeutically, Rock Pink has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
